problem_statement: Relay deployments now inject an `MtaClient` instead of the retired `SmtpPool`, and `UpstreamWorker` still calls the legacy `SmtpPool.send`, so every relay request fails with `AttributeError: 'MtaClient' object has no attribute 'send'`. Please migrate `relay/upstream_worker.py` to the `MtaClient.submit` / `Envelope` API, following the already-migrated module in `reference/`. Batch outcomes should carry the queue id and status from the MTA receipt, so batches the MTA defers are reported as `deferred` instead of `queued`. The expected behaviour is covered by `tests/test_upstream_worker.py`.
